hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (2 cores available to container)

failure_summary: demo_colmap.py was terminated by SIGTERM from PID 0 (host OOM killer) during torch random weight initialization (at::uniform_ inside VGGT() constructor), before the facebook/VGGT-1B checkpoint download. VGGT-1B needs >=4GB fp32 just for parameter init plus ~5GB for the state dict; the host had ~4GB available RAM and no swap.
blockers: Insufficient RAM on host: process OOM-killed during VGGT() fp32 parameter initialization.
facebook/VGGT-1B checkpoint is 5.03GB and would exceed host RAM together with model weights even if init succeeded.
CPU-only host: upstream assumes CUDA (torch.cuda.amp.autocast paths); a local compat patch was applied so the run could proceed to the real resource failure (see patch).

evidence.log_tail: *** SIGTERM ... received by PID 23955 (TID ...) from PID 0 ... stack in at::uniform_ / VGGT weight init; 'Upstream engine exited with code -15.'
evidence.patch_note: Upstream demo_colmap.py called torch.cuda.get_device_capability() unconditionally and crashed on CPU-only hosts; the patch gates dtype selection on torch.cuda.is_available(). Applied to the local .validation checkout only; recorded as a diff for audit.
